## 2. Core Technical Competencies

### 2.1 AI Systems & Agentic Engineering
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Designing and implementing JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP servers (v1.x) with strict schema validation, stdio & SSE transports, read-only resource endpoints, and prompt templates.
- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarms:** Orchestrating task-specific collaborative sub-agents (LangGraph, state transition graphs) for sensor data ingestion, quality inspection, logistics routing, and financial reconciliation.
- **Context & Cache Optimization:** Deterministic JSON output formatting to maximize KV-cache prefix hit rates (>85%) and minimize token expenditure across frontier models.
- **Tool Calling & Structured Outputs:** Building type-safe function calling bridges connecting LLM agents to production SQL databases, IoT telemetries, and ERP platforms.

### 2.2 Modern Fullstack & Edge Architecture
- **Frameworks:** React 19, TanStack Start (SSR), TanStack Router (type-safe routing), Vite 7.
- **Languages:** TypeScript 5.8+ (Strict Mode), Python 3.12+, SQL.
- **Styling & Design System:** Tailwind CSS v4, OKLCH color palettes, custom micro-interactions, Lenis smooth scrolling.
- **Edge Deployment:** Cloudflare Pages & Workers, zero-cold start serverless SSR execution.

### 2.3 Agro-Industrial & Supply Chain Expertise
- **Certifications:** BNSP Sektor Industri Agro — Klaster Perencanaan Produksi (2019), BNSP Pelatih Kewirausahaan UMKM.
- **Coffee Standards:** Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) Coffee Value Assessment (CVA) protocols, cupping sensory evaluation, and export-grade lot grading.
- **Regional Footprint:** Over 20 years of active field engagement across Barru, Toraja, Sinjai, and Enrekang in South Sulawesi.
- **Village Economic Sovereignty:** Designing digital governance and accounting systems for Badan Usaha Milik Desa (BUMDes) and customary community enterprises (BUMMA).

## 3. Flagship Projects & Case Studies

### 3.1 AgroAgent MCP Server (2026)
- **URL:** https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/agroagent-mcp
- **Category:** AI Protocol Infrastructure
- **Stack:** MCP v1.x, TypeScript, JSON-RPC, Cloudflare Edge.
- **Overview:** A standardized Model Context Protocol server exposing coffee harvest telemetry, SCA sensory scores, and cooperative inventory to AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Gemini Live).
- **Impact:** Eliminates data drift between mountain wet mills and AI assistants with sub-40ms response latency.

### 3.2 Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestrator (2026)
- **URL:** https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/agent-swarm
- **Category:** Autonomous AI Systems
- **Stack:** LangGraph, Multi-Agent Swarm, Telemetry Sensors, Decision Graph.
- **Overview:** A distributed 4-agent collaborative pipeline: (1) Harvest Telemetry Scout, (2) SCA Sensory Analyst, (3) Highland Logistics Router, and (4) Coop Escrow & Ledger Guard.
- **Impact:** 3.4x faster dispatch turnaround from highland farms to port cities with 100% digital provenance audit trail.

### 3.3 beanhub.online (2025)
- **URL:** https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/beanhub | https://beanhub.online
- **Category:** Supply Chain Traceability Platform
- **Stack:** React 19, SQL, Logistics Operations.
- **Overview:** An end-to-end coffee supply chain recording platform connecting smallholder farmers to commercial roasteries in South Sulawesi.
- **Impact:** Transparent transaction records and fair pricing verified across 7+ regional districts.

### 3.4 CuppingNotes.online (2026)
- **URL:** https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/cuppingnotes | https://cuppingnotes.online
- **Category:** Coffee Quality & Sensory Evaluation
- **Stack:** Angular, Firebase, SSR, SCA Sensory Standards.
- **Overview:** A mobile-first SCA coffee cupping application featuring an interactive flavor radar wheel, automated scoring, and shareable lot profiles for Q-Graders.

### 3.5 Kafeya POS (2025)
- **URL:** https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/kafeya
- **Category:** Micro-Accounting & Point of Sale
- **Stack:** React, Offline-First, Micro-Enterprise Accounting.
- **Overview:** Simplified cashier and financial reporting tool built specifically for small coffee shop owners and UMKM in Indonesia.

### 3.6 Pandu Desa 4.0 (2018)
- **URL:** https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/pandudesa
- **Category:** Village Digital Governance
- **Stack:** GIS Mapping, Digital Literacy Curriculum, Policy Advisory.
- **Overview:** Digital sovereignty initiative establishing transparent village administrative databases and local commodity mapping.
